topics: Christ's Atoning Work and Redemption through the Cross
Creation as Testimony to God's Existence
The Authority and Perfection of Scripture (Law, Statutes, Commandments, Judgments)
The Fear of the Lord as Reverence and Basis for Holiness
Sin, Its Dominion, and Freedom in Christ
The Role of the Holy Spirit in Conviction and Sanctification
sentimentFlow: The sermon starts light and joyful with upbeat worship, awe at creation, and delight in God's word, keeping an overall positive and reverent tone. It briefly turns heavier in the middle by confronting hidden sins and the struggle against wrongdoing, prompting honest self-reflection. It then rises to a hopeful, uplifting close with themes of freedom, forgiveness, and loving redemption.
